- **Inputs**:

    - The repaired or unchanged code block is then formatted back into a Mermaid code block.
    - The `MERMAID_RE.sub` method is used to apply the `_replace` function to all Mermaid code blocks in the text.
- **Output**: The function returns the updated text with all Mermaid diagrams either repaired to be renderable or left unchanged if no valid fix was found within the specified attempts.
